In the event of movable signs the count toward aspected signs be forward and in that of fixed signs, the counting upto the aspected sign be in the reverse order. If the 11th house from the Dasa-sign is occupied by a malefic or benefic planet, that Dasa will invariably be beneficial. Dasa-sign conjunct with or being in the sign of a benefic planet, such Dasa will always deliver auspicious results. An auspicious sign if is conjunct with a malefic planet, that Dasa of the sign will first give favourable and then unfavourable results. If inauspicious sign is having a conjunction of a benefic planet, it will also first give beneficial and then deleterious results. Should there be malefic planet in the inauspicious sign, the Dasa of this sign will usher all round harmful results. If there are both benefic and malefic planets in an auspicious sign, the Dasa of such a sign will undoubtedly, provide first the detrimental and then advantageous results.
